current.text: He is in the projected Clippers starting five with Darius Garland, Max Strus, Rui Hachimura and Isaiah Jackson. The expert is not confident about this lineup.
The Clippers have many injured players now, including Ingram, Beal, Jordan Miller and Konan Niederhauser.
He should start but will lose value when the injured Clippers return.
His rank in the 200s is fair. Experts do not want to invest in him and would consider him only in 16-team leagues.
The Clippers rotation is unsettled. The expert expects a trial season with long rotations, and coach Ty Lue often changes his rotation choices.
The Clippers play 4, 3 and 4 games in our fantasy playoff weeks. They have 13 back-to-backs, one of the lowest totals in the league.
